name: Translate PR #193 Beads DAG through R58 into dependency-local pull requests

description: Baseline: PR #193 roadmap has no per-plan Beads-to-PR mappings yet

asi.finding: The authoritative DAG now has 101 unique roadmap labels, 281 blocking edges plus hierarchy, no cycles, and nine dependency-ready untranslated plans. PR #193 is the qualifying R0 PR.
asi.validation: Roadmap 7-case selftest passed; live 79-file/50,576-line drift check passed; ledger has no UNANALYSED/UNCLASSIFIED rows; bd dep cycles passed; metric false_positives=0.

asi.next_action_hint: Close R0 after pushing the updated PR193 branch, then launch the nine dependency-ready nodes in disjoint worktrees, prioritizing D2/D3/R0B1/R0B2/R3/R6A-R6D.

description: Nine ready lanes claimed and running; no new qualifying PR completed yet

asi.hypothesis: Running all nine dependency-ready nodes in disjoint worktrees should maximize near-term plan-to-PR throughput without coupling unrelated stacks.

asi.next_action_hint: Finish the active worker lanes, independently verify each PR mapping and checks, then update each Beads external_ref before the next measurement.

description: Active disjoint lanes still implementing; no qualifying PR boundary crossed
